Eligibility requires 10 years of employment for teachers hired on or after September 1, 1997 (except those receiving job-related disability retirement), or eligibility for retirement from the RI Employees Retirement System without an actuarial deduction for those retiring on or after June 30, 1989. For those retiring on or after September 1, 2004, retirees pay a monthly co-share of the premium equal to at least the amount paid by an active teacher with the same plan. Retirees/spouses age 65+ may waive Plan 65 for alternative coverage with riders, paying the cost difference, with Medicare as the primary carrier. End-of-year retirees receive Delta Dental and Blue Cross coverage through September 30. Retirees may purchase additional medical and dental coverage (including Vision Care, Co-pay prescription coverage, and Organ Transplant) during the district's open enrollment period (September 1-20, effective October 1) at the group premium rate, payable by the 20th of the preceding month. Retirees may also purchase these plans for a spouse/domestic partner under the same terms.
